hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Horsehead
function: The curved head at the well end of the beam whose arc keeps the bridle vertical over the well through the stroke.

tabs.overview: The arc is centered on the beam pivot so the polished rod moves straight up and down; it is removable to let a rig over the well.
tabs.safety: Removed or swung aside with the unit braked before a workover.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
